hallucinations.why: Overclaim: production serving commonly uses FP8/BF16; 4-bit dominates local use only

what_went_wrong: Long and confused output from model knowledge alone: it inverts the small-model caveat, credits 4-bit with cutting TTFT, and adds a bogus cache-hit benefit, under a muddled 'when it matters / when it doesn't' structure.
great_answer_would: In about five sentences, say small models lose the most, the speed-up is to decoding (bandwidth-bound), and a bigger 4-bit model beats a smaller 16-bit one.
notes: Correct parts: 16 levels with scale/zero-point, 70B at 140GB going to ~40GB, bandwidth-bound decoding, and 4-bit as a sweet spot for large models. 'Forcing complex decimal values' is loose wording. At 2,645 chars it ignores 'keep it short'.
